# KaTeX

KaTeX 0.18.7 is vendored from the official npm distribution:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.7.tgz

Included: the minified browser JavaScript, stylesheet, referenced fonts, and MIT
license. The article loads these local assets; it needs no CDN or npm build step.

Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser
